# Trip Fotos

> A React and Firebase app for discovering popular travel destinations shared by registered travellers. Anyone can browse a preview of each trip; full trips, every photo and messaging sit behind an email and password sign-in.

## Public pages

- [Travellers](https://trip-fotos-project-react.vercel.app/travellers): A preview of every trip, newest first, with a filter by city
- [Sign in or sign up](https://trip-fotos-project-react.vercel.app/authentication): Create an account or log in to browse travellers
- [Privacy policy](https://trip-fotos-project-react.vercel.app/privacy): What data the app collects and how it is used

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/andres-codigo/trip-fotos-react): Source code, setup instructions and documentation
